description: Shared wire fixtures between the hidden-burst JS spec (frontend/src/lib/audio/__tests__/audio-manager-hidden-burst.isolated.test.ts) and the paired Python handler test (tests/test_web_audio_rx_wire_fixture.py). The JS spec builds every RX frame from rx_frame_pcm16_mono_20ms and checks every audio_start request against audio_start_rx; the Python test drives the REAL /api/v1/audio handler with the same request and verifies the emitted binary frame against the same expectations.

audio_start_rx.description: Exact JSON the browser sends to subscribe to RX. Fields that vary per browser/session are listed in variableKeys and filled in by each consumer; both sides compare the stable subset for equality AND the key set (stable keys + variableKeys).

rx_frame_pcm16_mono_20ms.description: Golden RX binary frame exactly as the server emits it (see encode_audio_frame in src/rigplane/web/protocol.py: 8-byte header = msg_type, codec, sequence uint16 LE, sample_rate/100 uint16 LE, channels, frame_ms). The broadcaster numbers frames from sequence 0 on a fresh broadcaster, so the first emitted frame pins the header bytes exactly.
